g.text: SD-04 · View order (Meu pedido) / verify and hand over at pickup (UC-05, UC-06) · endpoints per 07-api-spec
(after checkout with ?new=1, from a home card, a shared link, or typed)
upper-case and check the code format
SELECT order, items (+product name, image), customer.name
code + "Copiar código" + "Compartilhar", first name · time · ready time,
items, "Total a pagar na loja", address, hours and pickup deadline
check items, charge at the counter, hand over (BR-18)
check the staff token (401 if missing or wrong)
